description: Read source-cited context from an ingested board snapshot: original text, table rows, cluster summaries and arrows with at least one end, or a section, frame or group around one, on the page, each with a Figma link. Start here for overviews, summaries and documentation with one call without topic, nodeIds, limit and maxChars: its first page names the largest sections and lists all sections with IDs. Then read sections, pages, frames or groups by passing their IDs as nodeIds (several IDs in one call share every page), read everything outside sections with outsideSections: true, search words with topic, or continue with cursor, and synthesize the answer yourself. Large pages can exceed client output limits. No network or LLM calls; does not refresh Figma content (use ingest_board).

boardId.description: The Figma file key returned by ingest_board

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page, unchanged; send it with the same topic, nodeIds, outsideSections, limit and maxChars

maxChars.description: Character budget for each representation: the readable text content and the JSON of structuredContent (default 12000, minimum 2000)

nodeIds.description: Read exact source nodes, all rows of a table or the row of a table cell, or every excerpt inside a page, section, frame or group by its ID (nested sections included, in reading order); several IDs in one call share every page in request order; cannot be combined with topic

outsideSections.description: Read every excerpt that lies in no section, cluster by cluster in reading order, tables row by row; on a board without sections, all excerpts. Cannot be combined with topic or nodeIds

snapshotId.description: Read a specific retained snapshot instead of the latest board

topic.description: Optional topic to focus the context on

name: get_board_context

modelDerived.description: True for model summaries and summaries whose non-model origin cannot be established

pageName.description: Page of this cluster's excerpts on this page of results; excerpts repeat it only where they differ

sectionNames.description: Enclosing sections, outermost first, of this cluster's excerpts; excerpts repeat them only where they differ

sourceNodeIds.description: Source nodes displayed on this page, not citations validating the cluster summary

summary.description: Model summary of the cluster; empty for deterministic clusters, whose excerpts carry the text, and where maxChars leaves no room for it

summarySource.description: Origin of the derived cluster summary; the summary is not verbatim source evidence

connections.description: Arrows with at least one end, or a section, frame or group around one, among this page's excerpts; never arrows to a page. The label is the text on the arrow

fromText.description: Short text or name of the start node when it is not among this page's excerpts, redacted like excerpts

toText.description: Short text or name of the end node when it is not among this page's excerpts, redacted like excerpts

contextText.description: Orientation: board header, page position, board overview or subsections. The excerpts are in evidence; the text content carries the readable version

pageName.description: Only for an excerpt outside the listed clusters or whose location differs from its cluster's

sectionNames.description: Same rule as pageName; an empty list means outside sections

relations.description: Cluster-to-cluster relations derived from connector arrows

label.description: Connector label(s), when the arrows are annotated

truncation.description: Explicit omissions from structured results and the readable text

omittedSummaries.description: Clusters on this page whose model summary is left empty to fit maxChars

title: Get Board Context
